import daycount = "./daycount.qui"
import schedule = "./schedule.qui"

class Flow(int days, real64 amount)

class Pillar(int maturity, int coupon, int frequency)

class ZeroCurve(int[] days, real64[] rates)
    real64 zero_rate(int day)
        if day <= days[0]
            return rates[0]
        if day >= days[-1]
            return rates[-1]
        index := 1
        while days[index] < day
            index += 1
        if days[index] == day
            return rates[index]
        weight := real64(day - days[index - 1]) / real64(days[index] - days[index - 1])
        return rates[index - 1] + (rates[index] - rates[index - 1]) * weight

    real64 discount(int day, real64 spread := 0.0)
        real64 rate := zero_rate(day) + spread
        years := day / 365
        remainder := day % 365
        real64 growth := 1.0
        for: iteration < years
            growth *= 1.0 + rate
        return 1.0 / (growth * (1.0 + rate * real64(remainder) / 365.0))

    real64 forward(int start, int finish)
        return (discount(start) / discount(finish) - 1.0) * 365.0 / real64(finish - start)

    ZeroCurve shifted(real64[] deltas)
        real64[] result := []
        for: index < #rates
            result = result.append(rates[index] + deltas[index])
        return ZeroCurve(days, result)

    real64 present_value(Flow[] flows, real64 spread := 0.0)
        real64 total := 0.0
        for flow := flows[]
            total += flow.amount * discount(flow.days, spread)
        return total

    real64 z_spread(Flow[] flows, real64 target)
        real64 low := -0.5
        real64 high := 0.5
        for: iteration < 80
            middle := (low + high) / 2.0
            if present_value(flows, middle) > target
                low = middle
            else
                high = middle
        return (low + high) / 2.0

ZeroCurve flat_curve(real64 rate)
    return ZeroCurve([0], [rate])

Flow[] par_bond_flows(int settlement, Pillar pillar)
    dates := schedule.coupon_schedule(settlement, pillar.maturity, pillar.frequency)
    Flow[] result := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#dates)
        fraction := daycount.year_fraction("30/360", dates[index - 1], dates[index])
        amount := real64(pillar.coupon) * real64(fraction.numerator) / (10000.0 * real64(fraction.denominator))
        if index == int(#dates) - 1
            amount += 1.0
        result = result.append(Flow(dates[index] - settlement, amount))
    return result

ZeroCurve bootstrap(int settlement, Pillar[] pillars)
    int[] days := []
    real64[] rates := []
    for pillar := pillars[]
        flows := par_bond_flows(settlement, pillar)
        days = days.append(pillar.maturity - settlement)
        real64 low := 0.0
        real64 high := 1.0
        for: iteration < 80
            middle := (low + high) / 2.0
            trial := ZeroCurve(days, rates.append(middle))
            if trial.present_value(flows) > 1.0
                low = middle
            else
                high = middle
        rates = rates.append((low + high) / 2.0)
    return ZeroCurve(days, rates)

bool leap(int year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

int year_length(int year)
    return if leap(year) then 366 else 365

int month_length(int year, int month)
    lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return if month == 2 and leap(year) then 29 else lengths[month - 1]

class Civil(int year, int month, int day)

Civil split_date(string text)
    return Civil(int(text[0:<4]), int(text[5:<7]), int(text[8:<10]))

bool valid(string text)
    value := split_date(text)
    return 2001 <= value.year <= 2099 and 1 <= value.month <= 12 and 1 <= value.day <= month_length(value.year, value.month)

int day_number(int year, int month, int day)
    result := day - 1
    if year >= 2000
        for: 2000 <= current < year
            result += year_length(current)
    else
        for: year <= current < 2000
            result -= year_length(current)
    for: 1 <= current < month
        result += month_length(year, current)
    return result

int parse(string text)
    value := split_date(text)
    return day_number(value.year, value.month, value.day)

Civil civil_date(int number)
    year := 2000
    while number < 0
        year -= 1
        number += year_length(year)
    while number >= year_length(year)
        number -= year_length(year)
        year += 1
    month := 1
    while number >= month_length(year, month)
        number -= month_length(year, month)
        month += 1
    return Civil(year, month, number + 1)

string pad(int number, int width)
    result := string(number)
    while int(#result) < width
        result = "0" + result
    return result

string format_date(int number)
    value := civil_date(number)
    return "{pad(value.year, 4)}-{pad(value.month, 2)}-{pad(value.day, 2)}"

class Calendar(int[] holidays)
    bool is_business_day(int number)
        weekday := (number + 5) % 7
        if weekday < 0
            weekday += 7
        if weekday >= 5
            return false
        for holiday := holidays[]
            if holiday == number
                return false
        return true

    int following(int number)
        while not is_business_day(number)
            number += 1
        return number

    int preceding(int number)
        while not is_business_day(number)
            number -= 1
        return number

    int adjust(int number, string convention)
        if convention == "FOLLOWING"
            return following(number)
        if convention == "PRECEDING"
            return preceding(number)
        if convention == "MODIFIED_FOLLOWING"
            next := following(number)
            return if civil_date(next).month == civil_date(number).month then next else preceding(number)
        return number

    int business_days(int number, int count, int direction)
        while count > 0
            number += direction
            if is_business_day(number)
                count -= 1
        return number

import dates = "./dates_calendar.qui"

class Fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    real64 value()
        return real64(numerator) / real64(denominator)

Fraction year_fraction(string convention, int start, int finish)
    left := dates.civil_date(start)
    right := dates.civil_date(finish)
    if convention == "30/360" or convention == "30E/360"
        if convention == "30/360"
            left_february := left.month == 2 and left.day == dates.month_length(left.year, 2)
            right_february := right.month == 2 and right.day == dates.month_length(right.year, 2)
            if left_february and right_february
                right.day = 30
            if left_february
                left.day = 30
            if right.day == 31 and left.day >= 30
                right.day = 30
            if left.day == 31
                left.day = 30
        else
            if left.day == 31
                left.day = 30
            if right.day == 31
                right.day = 30
        return Fraction(360 * (right.year - left.year) + 30 * (right.month - left.month) + right.day - left.day, 360)
    if convention == "ACT/360"
        return Fraction(finish - start, 360)
    if convention == "ACT/365F"
        return Fraction(finish - start, 365)
    leap_days := 0
    other_days := 0
    year := left.year
    cursor := start
    while cursor < finish
        boundary := dates.day_number(year + 1, 1, 1)
        if boundary > finish
            boundary = finish
        if dates.leap(year)
            leap_days += boundary - cursor
        else
            other_days += boundary - cursor
        cursor = boundary
        year += 1
    return Fraction(365 * leap_days + 366 * other_days, 133590)

bool has_word(string[] words, string target)
    for word := words[]
        if word == target
            return true
    return false

bool has_day(int[] days, int target)
    for day := days[]
        if day == target
            return true
    return false

bool valid_frequency(int frequency)
    return frequency == 1 or frequency == 2 or frequency == 4 or frequency == 12

int round_half_up(int numerator, int denominator)
    return (2 * numerator + denominator) / (2 * denominator)

string format_hundredths(int value)
    if value < 0
        return "-" + format_hundredths(-value)
    return "{value / 100}.{dates.pad(value % 100, 2)}"

string format_decimal(real64 value, int digits)
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    real64 threshold := if digits == 2 then 0.005 elif digits == 4 then 0.00005 else 0.0000005
    if magnitude < threshold
        value = 0.0
    if digits == 2
        return "{value:.2}"
    if digits == 4
        return "{value:.4}"
    return "{value:.6}"

string format_percent(real64 value)
    return format_decimal(value * 100.0, 4)

string format_amount(real64 cents)
    return format_decimal(cents / 100.0, 2)

int thousandths(string text)
    pieces := text.split(".")
    return 1000 * int(pieces[0]) + int(pieces[1])

Params read_params()

class Fixings(int[] days, int[] rates)
    int latest(int day)
        result := -1
        for: index < #days
            if days[index] > day
                break
            result = rates[index]
        return result

Fixings read_fixings()

curve.Pillar[] validate_pillars(int settlement, string[] &errors)
    string[] seen := []
    curve.Pillar[] result := []
    for row := read_rows("curve_quotes.csv")[]
        key := row.fields[0]
        failure := ""
        maturity := 0
        frequency := int(row.fields[2])
        if has_word(seen, key)
            failure = "duplicate pillar"
        elif not dates.valid(key)
            failure = "invalid date"
        else
            maturity = dates.parse(key)
            if maturity <= settlement
                failure = "pillar not after settlement"
            elif not valid_frequency(frequency)
                failure = "invalid frequency"
        seen = seen.append(key)
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("curve_quotes.csv:{row.number}: {key}: {failure}")
        else
            result = result.append(curve.Pillar(maturity, int(row.fields[1]), frequency))
    maturity_keys := [for pillar := result[] then pillar.maturity]
    return result.sorted(by = maturity_keys)

Scenario[] validate_scenarios(ScenarioInput[] scenarios, int count, string[] &errors)
    string[] seen := []
    Scenario[] result := []
    for scenario := scenarios[]
        failure := ""
        if has_word(seen, scenario.name)
            failure = "duplicate scenario"
        elif int(#scenario.shifts) != count
            failure = "wrong number of shifts"
        seen = seen.append(scenario.name)
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("params.txt:{scenario.line}: {scenario.name}: {failure}")
        else
            real64[] deltas := []
            for shift := scenario.shifts[]
                deltas = deltas.append(real64(shift) * 0.0001)
            result = result.append(Scenario(scenario.name, deltas))
    return result

class OptionDate(string text, int amount)

class Special(int day, int amount)

class Options()
    end_of_month := false
    long_stub := false
    lag := 0
    cap := 1200
    floor := 0
    OptionDate[] sinks := []
    OptionDate[] calls := []

Options | error parse_options(string kind, string text)
    result := Options()
    allowed := ["EOM", "LONG"]
    if kind == "FIXED"
        allowed = allowed.append("CALL")
    elif kind == "AMORT"
        allowed = allowed.append("SINK")
    elif kind == "FRN"
        allowed = allowed.concat(["LAG", "CAP", "FLOOR"])
    string[] seen := []
    if text != "-"
        for item := text.split(";")[]
            pieces := item.split("=")
            key := pieces[0]
            if not has_word(allowed, key) or (has_word(seen, key) and key != "SINK" and key != "CALL")
                return error("invalid option")
            seen = seen.append(key)
            if key == "EOM"
                result.end_of_month = true
            elif key == "LONG"
                result.long_stub = true
            elif key == "LAG"
                result.lag = int(pieces[1])
            elif key == "CAP"
                result.cap = int(pieces[1])
            elif key == "FLOOR"
                result.floor = int(pieces[1])
            else
                value := pieces[1].split(":")
                if key == "SINK"
                    result.sinks = result.sinks.append(OptionDate(value[0], int(value[1])))
                else
                    result.calls = result.calls.append(OptionDate(value[0], thousandths(value[1])))
    if kind == "FRN" and (result.lag < 1 or result.lag > 5 or result.cap > 1200 or result.floor > result.cap)
        return error("invalid option")
    return result

Special[] | error validate_schedule(OptionDate[] items, int[] schedule, bool calls)
    Special[] result := []
    previous := -1
    failure := if calls then "invalid call schedule" else "invalid sinking fund"
    for item := items[]
        if not dates.valid(item.text)
            return error(failure)
        day := dates.parse(item.text)
        if not has_day(schedule[1:<#schedule - 1], day) or day <= previous
            return error(failure)
        if (calls and (item.amount < 100000 or item.amount > 110000)) or (not calls and item.amount == 0)
            return error(failure)
        result = result.append(Special(day, item.amount))
        previous = day
    return result

class Period(int number, int start, int finish, int payment, int numerator, int denominator, int rate, int opening, int principal)
    coupon := round_half_up(opening * rate * numerator, 10000 * denominator)
    cash_flow := coupon + principal

class Bond(string code, string kind, int issue, int maturity, int coupon, int frequency, string daycount, string bdc, int face, Options options)
    int[] schedule := []
    Special[] sinks := []
    Special[] calls := []
    Period[] periods := []

Bond | error parse_bond(string[] fields, bool duplicate, dates.Calendar calendar, Fixings fixings)
    if duplicate
        return error("duplicate id")
    kind := fields[1]
    if not has_word(["FIXED", "ZERO", "AMORT", "FRN"], kind)
        return error("unknown type")
    if not dates.valid(fields[2]) or not dates.valid(fields[3])
        return error("invalid date")
    issue := dates.parse(fields[2])
    maturity := dates.parse(fields[3])
    if maturity <= issue
        return error("maturity not after issue")
    frequency := int(fields[5])
    if not valid_frequency(frequency)
        return error("invalid frequency")
    if not has_word(["30/360", "30E/360", "ACT/360", "ACT/365F", "ACT/ACT"], fields[6])
        return error("unknown day count")
    if not has_word(["FOLLOWING", "MODIFIED_FOLLOWING", "PRECEDING", "UNADJUSTED"], fields[7])
        return error("unknown business day rule")
    face := int(fields[8])
    if face % 100000 != 0 or face > 10000000
        return error("invalid face")
    coupon := int(fields[4])
    if coupon > 1200 or (kind == "ZERO" and coupon != 0)
        return error("invalid coupon")
    options := try parse_options(kind, fields[9])
    result := Bond(fields[0], kind, issue, maturity, coupon, frequency, fields[6], fields[7], face, options)
    result.schedule = sched.coupon_schedule(issue, maturity, frequency, options.end_of_month, options.long_stub)
    result.sinks = try validate_schedule(options.sinks, result.schedule, false)
    sink_total := 0
    for sink := result.sinks[]
        sink_total += sink.amount
    if kind == "AMORT" and (sink_total == 0 or sink_total >= face)
        return error("invalid sinking fund")
    result.calls = try validate_schedule(options.calls, result.schedule, true)
    opening := face
    for: 1 <= number < int(#result.schedule)
        start := result.schedule[number - 1]
        finish := result.schedule[number]
        rate := coupon
        if kind == "ZERO"
            rate = 0
        elif kind == "FRN"
            reset := calendar.business_days(calendar.adjust(start, result.bdc), options.lag, -1)
            index_rate := fixings.latest(reset)
            if index_rate < 0
                return error("missing fixing")
            rate += index_rate
            if rate < options.floor
                rate = options.floor
            if rate > options.cap
                rate = options.cap
        principal := 0
        if number == int(#result.schedule) - 1
            principal = opening
        else
            for sink := result.sinks[]
                if sink.day == finish
                    principal = sink.amount
        fraction := dc.year_fraction(result.daycount, start, finish)
        result.periods = result.periods.append(Period(number, start, finish, calendar.adjust(finish, result.bdc), fraction.numerator, fraction.denominator, rate, opening, principal))
        opening -= principal
    return result

Bond[] validate_bonds(dates.Calendar calendar, Fixings fixings, string[] &errors)
    string[] seen := []
    Bond[] result := []
    for row := read_rows("bonds.csv")[]
        duplicate := has_word(seen, row.fields[0])

            Bond bond
                result = result.append(bond)
            error problem

    return result

int bond_index(Bond[] bonds, string code)
    for: index < #bonds
        if bonds[index].code == code
            return int(index)
    return -1

class Valuation(Bond bond, int clean, local int settlement)
    local current := 0
    while bond.periods[current].finish <= settlement
        current += 1
    local first := bond.periods[current]
    Period[] remaining := bond.periods[current:<#bond.periods]
    int outstanding := first.opening
    local accrued_fraction := dc.year_fraction(bond.daycount, first.start, settlement)
    real64 accrued := real64(first.rate * accrued_fraction.numerator) / real64(100 * accrued_fraction.denominator)
    int accrued_amount := round_half_up(outstanding * first.rate * accrued_fraction.numerator, 10000 * accrued_fraction.denominator)
    clean_amount := round_half_up(outstanding * clean, 100000)
    unit_value := clean_amount + accrued_amount
    target := real64(clean) / 1000.0 + accrued
    local remaining_fraction := dc.year_fraction(bond.daycount, settlement, first.finish)
    real64 fraction := real64(bond.frequency * remaining_fraction.numerator) / real64(remaining_fraction.denominator)
    Period[] cash_flows := []
    curve.Flow[] flows := []
    local int[] amounts := []
    for period := remaining[]
        amounts = amounts.append(period.cash_flow)
        if period.cash_flow > 0
            cash_flows = cash_flows.append(period)
            flows = flows.append(curve.Flow(period.payment - settlement, real64(period.cash_flow)))
    pricer := pricing.YieldPricer(amounts, fraction, bond.frequency, outstanding)
    real64 ytm := 0.0
    risk := pricing.RiskMeasures(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    real64 ytw := 0.0
    int workout := bond.maturity
    real64 wal := 0.0
    int next_payment := cash_flows[0].payment
    real64 curve_clean := 0.0
    real64 zspread := 0.0

    real64 yield_to_call(Special call)
        int[] values := []
        for period := remaining[]
            amount := period.coupon
            if period.finish == call.day
                amount += round_half_up(period.opening * call.amount, 100000)
            values = values.append(amount)
            if period.finish == call.day
                break
        callable := pricing.YieldPricer(values, fraction, bond.frequency, outstanding)
        return callable.solve(target)

    void .analyze(curve.ZeroCurve zero, int evaluation_day)
        ytm = pricer.solve(target)
        risk = pricer.risk(ytm)
        ytw = ytm
        for call := bond.calls[]
            if call.day > evaluation_day
                real64 yield_value := yield_to_call(call)
                if yield_value < ytw
                    ytw = yield_value
                    workout = call.day
        principal_days := 0
        for: index < #cash_flows
            principal_days += cash_flows[index].principal * flows[index].days
        wal = real64(principal_days) / real64(365 * outstanding)
        curve_clean = zero.present_value(flows) * 100.0 / real64(outstanding) - accrued
        zspread = zero.z_spread(flows, real64(unit_value))

int valuation_index(Valuation[] valuations, string code)
    for: index < #valuations
        if valuations[index].bond.code == code
            return int(index)
    return -1

Valuation[] validate_prices(Bond[] bonds, int settlement, string[] &errors)
    string[] seen := []
    Valuation[] result := []
    for row := read_rows("prices.csv")[]
        code := row.fields[0]
        index := bond_index(bonds, code)
        failure := ""
        if index < 0
            failure = "unknown bond"
        elif has_word(seen, code)
            failure = "duplicate price"
        elif not (bonds[index].issue <= settlement < bonds[index].maturity)
            failure = "not outstanding"
        else
            value := Valuation(bonds[index], thousandths(row.fields[1]), settlement)
            if not value.pricer.in_range(value.target)
                failure = "yield out of range"
            else
                result = result.append(value)
        seen = seen.append(code)
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("prices.csv:{row.number}: {code}: {failure}")
    return result

class Position(string portfolio, Valuation valuation)
    units := 0
    book := 0

    int market_value()
        return units * valuation.unit_value

    int face()
        return units * valuation.bond.face

    int outstanding()
        return units * valuation.outstanding

    int gain()
        return units * valuation.clean_amount - book

    real64 dv01()
        return valuation.risk.dv01 * real64(units) * real64(valuation.outstanding) / 10000.0

    real64 present_value(curve.ZeroCurve zero)
        return real64(units) * zero.present_value(valuation.flows, valuation.zspread)

Position[] validate_holdings(Bond[] bonds, Valuation[] valuations, string[] &errors)
    Position[] result := []
    for row := read_rows("holdings.csv")[]
        name := row.fields[0]
        code := row.fields[1]
        bond_id := bond_index(bonds, code)
        valuation_id := valuation_index(valuations, code)
        face := int(row.fields[2])
        failure := ""
        if bond_id < 0
            failure = "unknown bond"
        elif valuation_id < 0
            failure = "no price"
        elif face % bonds[bond_id].face != 0
            failure = "invalid face"
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("holdings.csv:{row.number}: {code}: {failure}")
            continue
        index := -1
        for: offset < #result
            if result[offset].portfolio == name and result[offset].valuation.bond.code == code
                index = int(offset)
                break
        if index < 0
            index = int(#result)
            result = result.append(Position(name, valuations[valuation_id]))
        units := face / bonds[bond_id].face
        result[index].units += units
        result[index].book += round_half_up(units * valuations[valuation_id].outstanding * thousandths(row.fields[3]), 100000)
    return result

int type_index(string kind)
    kinds := ["FIXED", "ZERO", "AMORT", "FRN"]
    for: index < #kinds
        if kinds[index] == kind
            return int(index)
    return -1

int bucket_index(int days)
    boundaries := [365, 1095, 1825, 3650]
    for: index < #boundaries
        if days < boundaries[index]
            return int(index)
    return 4

class Group(string label)
    count := 0
    value := 0
    real64 duration := 0.0
    real64 dv01 := 0.0

    void .add(Position position)
        market := position.market_value()
        count += 1
        value += market
        duration += real64(market) * position.valuation.risk.modified
        dv01 += position.dv01()

class Ladder(int year, coupon := 0, principal := 0)

class ScenarioResult(string name, real64[] values, real64[] pnls, real64 total, real64 pnl)

class Portfolio(string name, Position[] positions)
    total_value := 0
    for member := positions[]
        total_value += member.market_value()
    real64 ytm := 0.0
    real64 modified := 0.0
    real64 convexity := 0.0
    real64 zspread := 0.0
    real64 dv01 := 0.0
    real64 cash_yield := 0.0
    real64[] base_values := []
    real64 base_value := 0.0
    real64 effective := 0.0
    real64[] key_rates := []
    types := [Group("FIXED"), Group("ZERO"), Group("AMORT"), Group("FRN")]
    buckets := [Group("0-1Y"), Group("1-3Y"), Group("3-5Y"), Group("5-10Y"), Group("10Y+")]
    Ladder[] ladder := []
    ScenarioResult[] results := []

    real64 weight(int value)
        return real64(value) * 100.0 / real64(total_value)

    int income()
        result := 0
        for position := positions[]
            for: index < #position.valuation.cash_flows
                if position.valuation.flows[index].days <= 365
                    result += position.units * position.valuation.cash_flows[index].coupon
        return result

    real64 present_value(curve.ZeroCurve zero)
        real64 result := 0.0
        for position := positions[]
            result += position.present_value(zero)
        return result

    real64 rate_duration(curve.ZeroCurve zero, int pillar)
        real64[] down := array(#zero.rates, fill = 0.0)
        real64[] up := array(#zero.rates, fill = 0.0)
        for: index < #zero.rates
            if pillar < 0 or int(index) == pillar
                down[index] = -0.0001
                up[index] = 0.0001
        return (present_value(zero.shifted(down)) - present_value(zero.shifted(up))) / (2.0 * 0.0001 * base_value)

    void .analyze(curve.ZeroCurve zero, Scenario[] scenarios, int settlement)
        curve.Flow[] aggregate := []
        for position := positions[]
            market := position.market_value()
            ytm += real64(market) * position.valuation.ytm
            modified += real64(market) * position.valuation.risk.modified
            convexity += real64(market) * position.valuation.risk.convexity
            zspread += real64(market) * position.valuation.zspread
            dv01 += position.dv01()
            for flow := position.valuation.flows[]
                aggregate = aggregate.append(curve.Flow(flow.days, real64(position.units) * flow.amount))
            base := position.present_value(zero)
            base_values = base_values.append(base)
            base_value += base
            .types[type_index(position.valuation.bond.kind)].add(position)
            .buckets[bucket_index(position.valuation.bond.maturity - settlement)].add(position)
            for period := position.valuation.cash_flows[]
                year := dates.civil_date(period.payment).year
                slot := -1
                for: index < #ladder
                    if ladder[index].year == year
                        slot = int(index)
                        break
                if slot < 0
                    slot = int(#ladder)
                    ladder = ladder.append(Ladder(year))
                ladder[slot].coupon += position.units * period.coupon
                ladder[slot].principal += position.units * period.principal
        ytm /= real64(total_value)
        modified /= real64(total_value)
        convexity /= real64(total_value)
        zspread /= real64(total_value)
        real64 low := 0.0
        real64 high := 1.0
        for: iteration < 80
            middle := (low + high) / 2.0
            flat := curve.flat_curve(middle)
            if flat.present_value(aggregate) > real64(total_value)
                low = middle
            else
                high = middle
        cash_yield = (low + high) / 2.0
        effective = rate_duration(zero, -1)
        for: index < #zero.rates
            key_rates = key_rates.append(rate_duration(zero, int(index)))
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#ladder)
            current := ladder[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and ladder[cursor - 1].year > current.year
                ladder[cursor] = ladder[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            ladder[cursor] = current
        Scenario[] all := [Scenario("BASE", array(#zero.rates, fill = 0.0))].concat(scenarios)
        for scenario := all[]
            shifted := zero.shifted(scenario.deltas)
            real64[] values := []
            real64[] pnls := []
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: index < #positions
                value := positions[index].present_value(shifted)
                values = values.append(value)
                pnls = pnls.append(value - base_values[index])
                total += value
            results = results.append(ScenarioResult(scenario.name, values, pnls, total, total - base_value))

    int worst_scenario()
        result := -1
        for: 1 <= index < int(#results)
            if result < 0 or results[index].pnl < results[result].pnl
                result = index
        return result

    string group_line(string category, Group group)
        return "{category} {group.label} positions {group.count} value {format_hundredths(group.value)} weight {format_decimal(weight(group.value), 4)} duration {format_decimal(group.duration / real64(total_value), 4)} dv01 {format_decimal(group.dv01, 2)}"

    string[] report_lines()
        lines := ["portfolio {name}"]
        total_face := 0
        total_outstanding := 0
        total_book := 0
        total_gain := 0
        for position := positions[]
            value := position.valuation
            code := value.bond.code
            lines = lines.append("position {code} face {format_hundredths(position.face())} outstanding {format_hundredths(position.outstanding())} clean {format_decimal(real64(value.clean) / 1000.0, 6)} value {format_hundredths(position.market_value())} weight {format_decimal(weight(position.market_value()), 4)} book {format_hundredths(position.book)} gain {format_hundredths(position.gain())} ytm {format_percent(value.ytm)} modified {format_decimal(value.risk.modified, 4)} dv01 {format_decimal(position.dv01(), 2)}")
            total_face += position.face()
            total_outstanding += position.outstanding()
            total_book += position.book
            total_gain += position.gain()
        lines = lines.append("total positions {#positions} face {format_hundredths(total_face)} outstanding {format_hundredths(total_outstanding)} value {format_hundredths(total_value)} book {format_hundredths(total_book)} gain {format_hundredths(total_gain)} income {format_hundredths(income())}")
        lines = lines.append("risk ytm {format_percent(ytm)} yield {format_percent(cash_yield)} modified {format_decimal(modified, 4)} convexity {format_decimal(convexity, 4)} zspread {format_percent(zspread)} dv01 {format_decimal(dv01, 2)}")
        string[] durations := []
        for value := key_rates[]
            durations = durations.append(format_decimal(value, 4))
        lines = lines.append("curve effective {format_decimal(effective, 4)} krd {durations.join(" ")}")
        for group := types[]
            lines = lines.append(group_line("type", group))
        for group := buckets[]
            lines = lines.append(group_line("bucket", group))
        total_coupon := 0
        total_principal := 0
        for entry := ladder[]
            lines = lines.append("ladder {entry.year} coupon {format_hundredths(entry.coupon)} principal {format_hundredths(entry.principal)} total {format_hundredths(entry.coupon + entry.principal)}")
            total_coupon += entry.coupon
            total_principal += entry.principal
        lines = lines.append("ladder total coupon {format_hundredths(total_coupon)} principal {format_hundredths(total_principal)} total {format_hundredths(total_coupon + total_principal)}")
        int worst := worst_scenario()
        if worst >= 0
            scenario := results[worst]
            int[] order := []
            for: index < #positions
                order = order.append(int(index))
            for: 1 <= offset < int(#order)
                current := order[offset]
                cursor := offset
                while cursor > 0 and scenario.pnls[order[cursor - 1]] > scenario.pnls[current]
                    order[cursor] = order[cursor - 1]
                    cursor -= 1
                order[cursor] = current
            string[] losers := []
            for: index < #order
                if index == 3
                    break
                losers = losers.concat([positions[order[index]].valuation.bond.code, format_amount(scenario.pnls[order[index]])])
            lines = lines.append("stress worst {scenario.name} pnl {format_amount(scenario.pnl)} losers {losers.join(" ")}")
        return lines

    string[] scenario_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for scenario := results[]
            for: index < #positions
                lines = lines.append("{name},{scenario.name},{positions[index].valuation.bond.code},{format_amount(scenario.values[index])},{format_amount(scenario.pnls[index])}")
            lines = lines.append("{name},{scenario.name},*,{format_amount(scenario.total)},{format_amount(scenario.pnl)}")
        return lines

    string[] compliance_lines(string[][] limits, int settlement)
        string[] lines := []
        breaches := 0
        for words := limits[]
            kind := words[0]
            details := ""
            breach := false
            if kind == "position_weight"
                largest := positions[0]
                for position := positions[]
                    if position.market_value() > largest.market_value()
                        largest = position
                limit := int(words[1])
                value := largest.market_value()
                details = "{largest.valuation.bond.code} {format_decimal(weight(value), 4)} limit {format_hundredths(limit)}"
                breach = value * 10000 > limit * total_value
            elif kind == "type_weight"
                limit := int(words[2])
                value := types[type_index(words[1])].value
                details = "{words[1]} {format_decimal(weight(value), 4)} limit {format_hundredths(limit)}"
                breach = value * 10000 > limit * total_value
            elif kind == "max_maturity"
                years := int(words[1])
                count := 0
                for position := positions[]
                    if position.valuation.bond.maturity - settlement > 365 * years
                        count += 1
                details = "{years}Y positions {count}"
                breach = count >= 1
            elif kind == "min_yield"
                limit := int(words[1])
                details = "{format_percent(ytm)} limit {format_hundredths(limit)}"
                breach = ytm * 10000.0 < real64(limit)
            elif kind == "duration"
                low := int(words[1])
                high := int(words[2])
                details = "{format_decimal(modified, 4)} range {format_hundredths(low)} {format_hundredths(high)}"
                breach = modified < real64(low) / 100.0 or modified > real64(high) / 100.0
            else
                limit := int(words[1])
                details = "{format_decimal(dv01, 2)} limit {format_hundredths(limit)}"
                breach = dv01 * 100.0 > real64(limit)
            if breach
                breaches += 1
            lines = lines.append("{name} {kind} {details} {if breach then "BREACH" else "PASS"}")
        return lines.append("{name} breaches {breaches}")

Portfolio[] build_portfolios(Position[] positions)
    string[] names := []
    for position := positions[]
        if not has_word(names, position.portfolio)
            names = names.append(position.portfolio)
    Portfolio[] result := []
    for name := names.sorted()[]
        string[] codes := []
        for position := positions[]
            if position.portfolio == name
                codes = codes.append(position.valuation.bond.code)
        Position[] members := []
        for code := codes.sorted()[]
            for position := positions[]
                if position.portfolio == name and position.valuation.bond.code == code
                    members = members.append(position)
                    break
        result = result.append(Portfolio(name, members))
    return result

string[] cashflow_lines(Bond[] bonds)
    lines := ["bond,period,start,end,payment,fraction,rate_bp,outstanding,coupon,principal"]
    string[] codes := []
    for bond := bonds[]
        codes = codes.append(bond.code)
    for code := codes.sorted()[]
        bond := bonds[bond_index(bonds, code)]
        for period := bond.periods[]
            if period.cash_flow > 0
                fraction := real64(period.numerator) / real64(period.denominator)
                lines = lines.append("{code},{period.number},{dates.format_date(period.start)},{dates.format_date(period.finish)},{dates.format_date(period.payment)},{format_decimal(fraction, 6)},{period.rate},{period.opening},{period.coupon},{period.principal}")
    return lines

string[] analytics_lines(Valuation[] valuations)
    lines := ["bond,clean,accrued,dirty,ytm,ytw,workout,next_payment,wal,macaulay,modified,convexity,dv01,curve_clean,zspread"]
    string[] codes := []
    for value := valuations[]
        codes = codes.append(value.bond.code)
    for code := codes.sorted()[]
        value := valuations[valuation_index(valuations, code)]
        lines = lines.append("{code},{format_decimal(real64(value.clean) / 1000.0, 6)},{format_decimal(value.accrued, 6)},{format_decimal(value.target, 6)},{format_percent(value.ytm)},{format_percent(value.ytw)},{dates.format_date(value.workout)},{dates.format_date(value.next_payment)},{format_decimal(value.wal, 4)},{format_decimal(value.risk.macaulay, 4)},{format_decimal(value.risk.modified, 4)},{format_decimal(value.risk.convexity, 4)},{format_decimal(value.risk.dv01, 6)},{format_decimal(value.curve_clean, 6)},{format_percent(value.zspread)}")
    return lines

string[] curve_lines(int valuation, int settlement, curve.Pillar[] pillars, curve.ZeroCurve zero)
    lines := ["valuation {dates.format_date(valuation)} settlement {dates.format_date(settlement)}"]
    previous := 0
    for: index < #pillars
        pillar := pillars[index]
        days := zero.days[index]
        lines = lines.append("pillar {dates.format_date(pillar.maturity)} days {days} frequency {pillar.frequency} par {format_hundredths(pillar.coupon)} zero {format_percent(zero.rates[index])} df {format_decimal(zero.discount(days), 6)} forward {format_percent(zero.forward(previous, days))}")
        previous = days
    for: 1 <= year <= zero.days[-1] / 365
        days := year * 365
        lines = lines.append("grid {year}Y days {days} zero {format_percent(zero.zero_rate(days))} df {format_decimal(zero.discount(days), 6)} forward {format_percent(zero.forward(days - 365, days))}")
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

if main
    params := read_params()

class RiskMeasures(real64 macaulay, real64 modified, real64 convexity, real64 dv01)

class YieldPricer(int[] flows, real64 fraction, int frequency, int outstanding)
    real64[] present_values(real64 rate)
        first := 1.0 + fraction * rate / real64(frequency)
        growth := 1.0 + rate / real64(frequency)
        real64 factor := 1.0
        real64[] values := []
        for cash_flow := flows[]
            values = values.append(real64(cash_flow) / (first * factor))
            factor *= growth
        return values

    real64 dirty(real64 rate)
        real64 total := 0.0
        for value := present_values(rate)[]
            total += value
        return total * 100.0 / real64(outstanding)

    bool in_range(real64 target)
        return dirty(0.0) > target > dirty(1.0)

    real64 solve(real64 target)
        real64 low := 0.0
        real64 high := 1.0
        for: iteration < 80
            middle := (low + high) / 2.0
            if dirty(middle) > target
                low = middle
            else
                high = middle
        return (low + high) / 2.0

    RiskMeasures risk(real64 rate)
        growth := 1.0 + rate / real64(frequency)
        real64 total := 0.0
        real64 weighted := 0.0
        real64 curvature := 0.0
        real64[] values := present_values(rate)
        for: index < #values
            years := (real64(index) + fraction) / real64(frequency)
            total += values[index]
            weighted += years * values[index]
            curvature += years * (years + 1.0 / real64(frequency)) * values[index]
        macaulay := weighted / total
        convexity := curvature / (total * growth * growth)
        real64 dv01 := (dirty(rate - 0.0001) - dirty(rate + 0.0001)) / 2.0
        return RiskMeasures(macaulay, macaulay / growth, convexity, dv01)

import dates = "./dates_calendar.qui"

int[] coupon_schedule(int issue, int maturity, int frequency, end_of_month := false, long_stub := false)
    anchor := dates.civil_date(maturity)
    eom := end_of_month and anchor.day == dates.month_length(anchor.year, anchor.month)
    int[] result := []
    boundary := maturity
    count := 0
    while boundary > issue
        result = result.append(boundary)
        count += 1
        index := anchor.year * 12 + anchor.month - 1 - (12 / frequency) * count
        year := index / 12
        month := index % 12 + 1
        last := dates.month_length(year, month)
        day := if eom or anchor.day > last then last else anchor.day
        boundary = dates.day_number(year, month, day)
    if long_stub and boundary != issue and #result >= 2
        result = result[0:<#result - 1]
    return result.append(issue).sorted()
